name: Agricultural Marketing Information Network
description: Portal providing daily market prices of agricultural commodities from 7,000+ mandis across India.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Free access to real-time agricultural commodity prices, arrivals data, and market information for better price discovery.

eligibility_summary: Open to all farmers and market participants.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
description: Financing facility for investment in post-harvest management and community farming assets.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Interest subvention of 3% per annum on loans up to Rs. 2 crore for post-harvest infrastructure including warehouses, cold storage, and processing units.
benefits.source_text: Interest subvention of 3% per annum up to a limit of Rs 2 crore

eligibility_summary: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, marketing cooperative societies, SHGs, startups, and agri-entrepreneurs.

name: Agricultural Technology Management Agency
description: Scheme to strengthen agricultural extension system to promote technology dissemination at district level.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Training, demonstrations, exposure visits, and farm schools for technology adoption. Farmer Interest Groups supported.

eligibility_summary: All farmers in ATMA districts.

name: Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme
description: Scheme to promote dairy entrepreneurship by providing capital subsidy for establishment of dairy farms and infrastructure.
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

benefits.description: 25% capital subsidy (33.33% for SC/ST) for dairy projects through NABARD.
benefits.source_text: 25% of outlay as back ended capital subsidy for general category, 33.33% for SC/ST

eligibility_summary: Farmers, individual entrepreneurs, NGOs, companies, and cooperative societies.

name: National Agriculture Market
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Online trading platform ensuring transparent price discovery and better prices for farmers.

eligibility_summary: All farmers can sell produce through eNAM registered mandis.

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations
description: Central sector scheme for formation and promotion of 10,000 FPOs to enhance market access and bargaining power for small farmers.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Rs. 18 lakh per FPO over 3 years for formation and handholding. Equity grant up to Rs. 2,000 per member (max Rs. 15 lakh per FPO).
benefits.source_text: Financial assistance of Rs.18.00 lakh per FPO for a period of 3 years

eligibility_summary: Groups of farmers forming FPOs with minimum 300 members (100 in NE/hilly areas).

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Scheme providing short-term credit to farmers for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and consumption requirements at subsidized interest rates.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Credit limit based on land holding and crop pattern. Interest rate of 7% p.a. with 3% interest subvention for timely repayment (effective rate 4%).
benefits.source_text: Interest subvention of 2% and additional 3% prompt repayment incentive

eligibility_summary: All farmers (individual/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators), tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers.

application_steps.description: Visit nearest bank branch (scheduled commercial bank, cooperative bank, or RRB)
Fill KCC application form and submit documents

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

benefits.description: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per financial year. Wages as per state-notified rates (minimum Rs. 200-300 per day depending on state).
benefits.source_text: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year

eligibility_summary: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.

required_documents.name: Job Card
required_documents.description: MGNREGA Job Card issued by Gram Panchayat

application_steps.description: Apply for Job Card at Gram Panchayat
Demand work in writing or orally to Gram Panchayat

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture
description: Scheme for holistic growth of the horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root & tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, aromatic plants, coconut, cashew, and cocoa.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Subsidy for planting material, area expansion, protected cultivation, INM/IPM, organic farming, and post-harvest management.

eligibility_summary: All farmers engaged in horticulture cultivation.

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana
description: Sub-component of DAY-NRLM to empower women in agriculture and improve their participation in agri-based livelihoods.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

benefits.description: Capacity building, training in sustainable agriculture, and support for agri-based enterprises for women farmers.

eligibility_summary: Women farmers, especially from poor rural households.

name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region
description: Scheme to develop certified organic production in a value chain mode in North Eastern states.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Support for FPO formation, organic inputs, certification, processing, and marketing infrastructure.

eligibility_summary: Farmers in North Eastern states forming FPOs for organic farming.

name: Rural Infrastructure Development Fund
description: Fund maintained by NABARD for providing loans to state governments for rural infrastructure including irrigation, roads, and bridges.
ministry: NABARD / Ministry of Finance

benefits.description: Low-interest loans for rural infrastructure projects including minor irrigation, rural roads, and bridges.

eligibility_summary: State governments apply through NABARD for infrastructure projects.

name: National Bamboo Mission
description: Mission to promote bamboo sector through plantation development, processing, and market development.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Subsidies for bamboo plantation, treatment and seasoning plants, and product development.

eligibility_summary: Farmers and communities in identified bamboo growing regions.

name: National Food Security Mission
description: Mission to increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and commercial crops through area expansion and productivity enhancement.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Subsidized seeds, demonstrations, farm machinery, soil amendments, and INM/IPM inputs.

eligibility_summary: Farmers in identified districts under NFSM.

name: National Livestock Mission
description: Mission for sustainable development of livestock sector focusing on breed improvement, feed/fodder, and entrepreneurship development.
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

benefits.description: Capital subsidy up to 50% for various livestock entrepreneurship activities including poultry, sheep, goat, piggery ventures.

eligibility_summary: Farmers, cooperatives, SHGs, section 8 companies, FPOs engaged in livestock.

name: National Mission on Agricultural Extension and Technology
description: Mission to strengthen agricultural extension system using IT, mass media, and institutional interventions.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Free agricultural advisory services, Kisan Call Centers (1800-180-1551), and Kisan Suvidha app.

eligibility_summary: All farmers can access extension services.

name: National Mission on Oilseeds and Oil Palm
description: Mission to increase production and productivity of oilseeds and oil palm to reduce import dependency on edible oils.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Subsidies on quality seeds, distribution of minikits, and financial assistance for adoption of improved technologies.

eligibility_summary: Farmers growing oilseed crops are eligible.

name: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture
description: Mission to make agriculture more productive, sustainable, and climate resilient through adaptation measures.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Support for rainfed area development, soil health management, and climate change adaptation in agriculture.

eligibility_summary: All farmers, priority to rainfed area farmers.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
description: Mission to reduce rural poverty through sustainable livelihood opportunities and financial inclusion for rural poor households.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

benefits.description: Revolving fund support to SHGs, community investment fund, interest subvention on bank loans, and skill development.

eligibility_summary: Rural poor households, especially women, organized into SHGs.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
description: Scheme to promote organic farming through cluster-based approach with financial assistance.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Financial assistance for organic inputs, certification, and marketing for clusters of 20+ hectares.

eligibility_summary: Groups of farmers forming clusters of minimum 20 hectares in contiguous area.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
description: Scheme providing financial assistance for construction of pucca houses to eligible rural households.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

benefits.amount: Rs. 1.20 lakh (plain areas), Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly/IAP/difficult areas)
benefits.description: Financial assistance for house construction to eligible rural families.
benefits.source_text: Unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly States

eligibility_summary: Beneficiaries identified from SECC 2011 data based on housing deprivation parameters.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up micro-enterprises in non-farm sector and rural industries.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

benefits.description: 15-35% subsidy on project cost depending on area (rural/urban) and category (general/special).
benefits.source_text: Subsidy of 15-35% of the project cost

eligibility_summary: Any individual above 18 years. 8th pass for manufacturing projects above Rs.10 lakh and service above Rs.5 lakh.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Insurance coverage for crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Farmer premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for horticulture/commercial crops.
benefits.source_text: The farmer's share of premium is 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.

eligibility_summary: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas are eligible. Voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.

application_steps.description: Visit PMFBY portal, CSC, or nearest bank branch
Fill crop insurance application with crop and land details

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: National mission for financial inclusion ensuring access to banking, savings, insurance, pension, and credit.
ministry: Ministry of Finance

benefits.description: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card, Rs. 2 lakh accident insurance, Rs. 30,000 life insurance, and overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000.

eligibility_summary: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age without a bank account.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card or any identity proof

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance scheme providing Rs. 2 lakh life cover at a premium of Rs. 436 per annum.
ministry: Ministry of Finance

benefits.description: Life insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh for death due to any reason. Annual premium Rs. 436.
benefits.source_text: life cover of Rs. 2 Lakhs for death due to any reason at a premium of Rs. 436 per annum

eligibility_summary: All bank account holders aged 18-50 years.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan MaanDhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: Duplicate entry for testing - same as PM_KMY.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Same as PM-KMY

eligibility_summary: Same as PM-KMY.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
description: Scheme to expand cultivable area under irrigation, improve water use efficiency, and promote sustainable water conservation practices.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers on micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler).
benefits.source_text: 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers, 45% for other farmers

eligibility_summary: All farmers with agricultural land are eligible. Priority to small and marginal farmers.

application_steps.description: Apply through state agriculture department or district office

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance scheme providing Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death and full disability at Rs. 20 per annum.
ministry: Ministry of Finance

benefits.description: Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death/full disability, Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability. Premium Rs. 20/year.
benefits.source_text: Rs. 2 Lakh for accidental death and permanent total disability and Rs 1 Lakh for permanent partial disability

eligibility_summary: Bank account holders aged 18-70 years.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme providing Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all land-holding farmer families.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.frequency: 3 installments of Rs. 2,000 each per year
benefits.description: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments to the bank account of farmers.
benefits.source_text: Under the scheme an income support of Rs.6000/- per year is provided to all farmer families across the country in three equal installments of Rs.2000/- each every four months.

eligibility_summary: All land-holding farmer families are eligible. Certain categories of higher economic status are excluded.
exclusions: Government employees drawing monthly pension above Rs.10,000

application_steps.description: Visit PM-KISAN portal or nearest CSC center
Register with Aadhaar number, bank details, and land records

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing Rs. 3,000 monthly pension after age 60.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after attaining age of 60 years.
benefits.source_text: guaranteed pension of Rs.3000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years

eligibility_summary: Small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 years with cultivable land up to 2 hectares.

eligibility_rules.source_text: cultivable land up to 2 hectares (approx 5 acres)

application_steps.description: Visit nearest CSC center with Aadhaar and bank details

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
description: Scheme to promote solar energy among farmers by installing solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

benefits.description: Central and state subsidy of 60% for solar pumps. Farmer contribution is 40% (can avail bank loan for 30%).
benefits.source_text: Central Financial Assistance of 30% of the benchmark cost and State subsidy of 30%.

eligibility_summary: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, panchayats, and farmer producer organizations are eligible.

application_steps.description: Apply through state nodal agency or KUSUM portal

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - RAFTAAR
description: Scheme to incentivize states to increase public investment in agriculture and allied sectors.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Funding for state agriculture development plans, agri-infrastructure, and agripreneurship development.

eligibility_summary: Implemented through state governments based on State Agriculture Plans.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
description: Scheme to increase the reach of farm mechanization to small and marginal farmers through subsidies on purchase of agricultural machinery.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: 40-50% subsidy on agricultural machinery for small/marginal farmers. Custom hiring centers established for shared equipment access.

eligibility_summary: All farmers are eligible. Higher subsidy for SC/ST/small & marginal farmers and women.

application_steps.description: Apply on DBT Agriculture portal of respective state or district agriculture office

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Scheme to issue soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise recommendations on nutrients and fertilizers.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Free soil testing and soil health card with nutrient recommendations for improved crop productivity.

eligibility_summary: All farmers are eligible for free soil health cards.

application_steps.description: Contact local agriculture department or Krishi Vigyan Kendra

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa - AP Farmer Investment Support
description: Andhra Pradesh scheme providing Rs. 13,500 per year investment support to farmers.
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Andhra Pradesh

benefits.description: Rs. 13,500 per year in addition to PM-KISAN benefits (total Rs. 19,500 per year).
benefits.source_text: Rs.13,500/- per annum as investment support to every farmer family

eligibility_summary: All farmer families in Andhra Pradesh with cultivable land.

name: Raitha Siri - Karnataka Farmer Income Support
description: Karnataka state scheme providing additional income support to farmers beyond PM-KISAN.
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Karnataka

benefits.description: Additional income support to registered farmers in Karnataka state.

eligibility_summary: Registered farmers in Karnataka state.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi - Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra state scheme providing Rs. 6,000 per year to farmers in addition to PM-KISAN.
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Maharashtra

benefits.description: Rs. 6,000 per year in addition to PM-KISAN (total Rs. 12,000/year).

eligibility_summary: All PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers in Maharashtra.

name: Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam - Tamil Nadu
description: Tamil Nadu farmer protection scheme providing free crop insurance and financial assistance.
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Tamil Nadu

benefits.description: Free crop insurance for notified crops and financial assistance for crop loss.

eligibility_summary: All registered farmers in Tamil Nadu.

name: Rythu Bandhu - Telangana Farmer Investment Support
description: Telangana state scheme providing Rs. 10,000 per acre per year for crop investment support.
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Telangana

benefits.description: Rs. 5,000 per acre per season (2 seasons) for purchase of inputs.

eligibility_summary: All farmers owning agricultural land in Telangana.

name: UP Kisan Kalyan Mission
description: Uttar Pradesh comprehensive farmer welfare mission covering income support, crop insurance, and soil health.
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Uttar Pradesh

benefits.description: Integrated farmer welfare package including free seeds, soil testing, and crop advisory services.

eligibility_summary: All farmers registered in Uttar Pradesh.
